functions.description: Combat texture and frame table loader
functions.lever: wrapped both the frame-copy loop and the triple-set loop in a single if (frames.count > 0); copy the working cursor from a separate parameter (data = src + 4) so it takes r4; post-increment pa/pb/pc after the stores
functions.notes: Verified with wgate.py. Compiles under the original symbol func_02047b40 (extern C). Per-iteration reads use typed structs (FileGroup, FileTexture), no raw offset reads. No volatile, comments or pragmas.
